scenario: I and ten divers are part of an U.N. team who is deactivating anti-ship mines from World War II. One team member has hurt himself and the blood in the water has attracted several sharks. I have an underwater rifle but only one harpoon and there are many sharks. The bleeding diver is swimming towards the last protective cage and will reach it before me and the others. The sharks, following the blood, are coming too close for me and the other divers to escape. If I shoot at the injured diver this will kill him and the sharks will stop to eat him, but I and the ten divers will be saved.
choice: I decide to let the sharks eat the injured diver by shooting at him
entities: i,the injured diver,the other uninjured divers,the sharks
outcomes: The sharks attack and eat the injured diver.
The sharks stop pursuing me and the other divers.
I survive the immediate shark threat.
The other divers survive the immediate shark threat.
